  • 21.1% of children and adolescents aged 2–19 had obesity in August 2021–August 2023.
  • Obesity was 22.9% at ages 12–19, 22.1% at ages 6–11 and 14.9% at ages 2–5.
  • Severe obesity (BMI at or above 120% of the 95th percentile) affected 7.0% of children and adolescents.
